title: Antilipschitz charts pull back Hⁿ-null sets to Lⁿ-null sets
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ and c > 0 with c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω. Then for every Z ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(Z) = 0 we have Lⁿ(Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(Z)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∀ Z : Set (Eucl P), (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) Z = 0 → (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' Z) = 0
